source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
If every model in your army has **CHAOS KNIGHTS** or **HERETIC ASTARTES**, your army can field **LEGIONES DAEMONICA** units, even without the Faction keyword you picked when you [selected your Army Faction](vsdata:core-rule/select-army-faction). Their combined points cap is set by your [battle size](vsdata:core-rule/select-battle-size):

- 250 points at most at Incursion
- 500 points at most at Strike Force
- 750 points at most at Onslaught

None of them can be your **WARLORD** or be given Enhancements.

For each of **KHORNE**, **TZEENTCH**, **NURGLE** and **SLAANESH**, the units with that keyword your army includes this way that are not **BATTLELINE** cannot outnumber the **BATTLELINE** units with it that it includes this way.
